evidence.quote: During its last quarterly conference call, management forecast that it expects hyperscaler spending to top $1 trillion in 2027 after reaching a projected $650 billion in 2026 .
evidence.one_line: Nvidia management said on its last quarterly call it expects hyperscaler spending to top $1 trillion in 2027 after a projected $650 billion in 2026.
evidence.speaker: Nvidia management (as retold by author)

evidence.quote: For the rest of this year, they expect 82% growth. For 2027, that figure rises to 41%.
evidence.one_line: Wall Street analysts project 82% revenue growth for the rest of the current year and 41% growth for 2027.
evidence.speaker: Wall Street analysts (as retold by author)

evidence.quote: For fiscal 2028, ending January 2028, the average analyst projects $12.76 in earnings per share.
evidence.one_line: The average analyst projects fiscal 2028 earnings per share of $12.76.
evidence.speaker: Average analyst (as retold by author)

evidence.quote: If we use that figure and value the stock at a reasonable earnings multiple of 25, the projected share price at the end of fiscal 2028 is $319.
evidence.one_line: Author's valuation: at a 25x multiple on $12.76 EPS, the projected share price at end of fiscal 2028 is $319.
evidence.speaker: Keithen Drury (author)
